root_cause_hypothesis: Real-time physics/ROS message timing jitter in the Gazebo-based evaluation harness, not the --seed argument (which controls Gazebo's PRNG but not wall-clock-dependent message scheduling). Consistent with repeated 'Moved backwards in time, re-publishing joint transforms' warnings observed across these runs.
implication: Every single-episode-per-seed number reported elsewhere in this project (including the Protocol B five-world matrix and the Baseline/HighDiscovery ablation arms, each evaluated only once per seed) carries this same undisclosed uncertainty. Recommended follow-up: 5-10 repeated passes per configuration before treating any effect size as established.
